title: Personalized Pickleball Family Christmas Shirt 2026, Custom Last Name Matching Pickleball Sweatshirt
description:
Matching shirts for the whole pickleball family, with your last name front and centre. Perfect for Christmas photos and holiday tournaments.

Who it's for:
- Pickleball families who want matching Christmas outfits
- Grandparents buying for the whole crew
- Clubs and doubles teams that want a custom holiday shirt

About the design:
Personalise the name line (shown here as THE JOHNSONS) and the year. Crossed paddles frame a Santa-hatted pickleball under a string of lights. Flat, bold colours for a clean print.

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
alt_text: Personalized family Christmas design reading THE JOHNSONS 2026 with two paddles and a Santa-hatted pickleball on a maroon sweatshirt.
